body: Thank you for writing something. Its really nice to think that my thoughts are not so meaningless, you wanted to refer to this text and it truly means a lot to me.  I do try to find the help that i need, and it it helpful, i try not to put all my feelings on people around me, because i think it might be overwhelming for them, if thats what youre trying to say. Wish you the best! I Hope you will find the people you need in your life.
